Select approved drugs with the indication 'HIV infection'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno, then join molecule_dictionary again on mesh_id to filter by mesh_heading = 'HIV infection'. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
